name: FLOW Beat Link
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Sends each deck's beat, BPM, track and the mixer to FLOW VJ, and can lead Ableton Link from the deck.
description:
Rows: Send beat to FLOW (on), Send mixer to FLOW (on), Send track analysis to FLOW (on), Ableton Link from this deck (off, test) and Send mixer data (test) (off).

Link: the playing deck leads the Ableton Link session on the deck's network (tempo, beat, bar), so Ableton and AUTO/PILOT follow with no computer bridge.

FLOW: UDP broadcast to port 9100 (or flow-beat:host in MODS/azmods.cfg): beats, BPM, titles, each deck's level, the track's rekordbox grid, waveform, phrases and cues, and the mixer's faders, EQ and FX. Uses Ableton Link (GPL-2.0-or-later). Reads files; never writes or patches the deck.
